name: Hünfelden (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically blue and yellow, charged above the centre with the municipal arms of Hünfelden (a red tower and a lion on white).
history: Municipal flag of Hünfelden; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Hünfelden arms — tower and lion on white
